additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Hope Cement Works permit issued EPR/BP3731VJ/V007
additional_sources.guard: Issued Environment Agency permit identifies Breedon Cement Limited, Hope Cement Works, Hope Valley S33 6RP and permit EPR/BP3731VJ/V007. Binding/identity evidence only; no annual observed GHG quantity is implied.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ IETF Phase 2 Spring 2022 competition winners - Hope Cement CCS
additional_sources.guard: Official GOV.UK project page explicitly states Hope Cement Works emits over 1 Mt CO2 per year, but does not attach that statement to a specific reporting year or verified-installation dataset row. Retain as facility-scale absolute context, not a dated measured candidate or parcel value.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency Citizen Space: Northfleet Paper Mill EPR/BJ7379IZ/V009 consultation and GHG appendix surface
additional_sources.guard: Current regulator consultation confirms Northfleet Paper Mill and exposes a dedicated Climate Change & GHG Permit appendix plus technical documents. Document availability strengthens provenance and current technical scope only; no annual GHG value is inferred from the listing.

additional_sources.title: Drax Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official annual report visually and textually verifies Drax Power Station average biomass supply-chain GHG intensity of 93.7 kgCO2e/MWh in 2024 plus stage shares. This is lifecycle intensity, not annual direct facility tonnes; no denominator is inferred.

additional_sources.title: Drax: DB Cargo UK HVO-powered services for Drax
additional_sources.guard: Official operator release estimates the HVO switch could reduce rail-freight carbon emissions by up to 90%, saving over 12,000 tonnes of carbon each year. This is estimated abatement from transport, not observed Drax Power Station annual emissions.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Palm Paper Saddlebow Paper Mill permit issued
additional_sources.guard: Issued Environment Agency permit confirms Palm Paper Limited, Saddlebow Paper Mill, Kings Lynn and permit EPR/FP3132UE/V007. It corroborates installation identity and historic permit lineage only; no observed GHG quantity is implied.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency supporting document: Immingham CHP Air Impact Assessment for PCC variation
additional_sources.guard: Regulatory supporting-document text states PCC could capture up to 3.3 million tonnes CO2 per year at full load. This is design capture capacity, independently corroborating project scale; it is not observed current emissions and is not added to operator capture claims.

additional_sources.title: Peak District National Park Authority: Hope Cement Works planning application NP/HPK/0326/0318
additional_sources.guard: Current local-planning record identifies operational Hope Works/Pindale Road and Breedon Cement Limited in 2026. It strengthens current site/spatial continuity only; planning records do not supply measured GHG values.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Facility-scale absolute statements without a specific reporting period, lifecycle intensities and other non-compatible metrics remain context and are not promoted to dated measured rows.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Issued permits and installation identifiers strengthen binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Technical-document discovery/provenance does not substitute for a directly readable numeric row.
guard_contract.ABATEMENT_CONTEXT: Estimated savings or future capture capacity are not observed emissions.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Planning/address evidence strengthens site continuity only and is not cadastral emissions measurement.

web_research_basis: Fresh official/public internet research on 2026-07-27 using GOV.UK/DESNZ, Environment Agency, Drax and Peak District National Park Authority sources. Drax Annual Report 2024 was visually checked at the 93.7 kgCO2e/MWh table. Hope >1 Mt CO2/year is explicit facility-scale context but lacks a specific reporting year, so no measured candidate is promoted. No OCR, graph interpolation, assumed denominator or duplicated abatement arithmetic is used.
